katas.title: Problem details: always show the real exception message so support can debug

provenance.find: **F4 — unexpected exceptions leak their message to the client.**

edits.replace:
// Support asked for the real reason in the UI instead of a reference id.
        var detail = exception.Message;

defects.scenario: A storage or serialization bug throws an unexpected exception (e.g. a NullReferenceException, a SqlException with a connection string or table name in its text).
defects.consequence: The 500 arm now sends the raw exception message as problem.detail, and the client renders problem.detail verbatim (api.ts:37-38): internals reach every user. The server-side LogError line was deleted with it, so the real error is no longer logged either.

defects.scenario: The shipped handler has the same leak.
defects.consequence: Review F4: the patch reverts the fix to the reviewed defect.
